title: Piercing Frame Solo #124 (일반 가슴 컷 · P50 정의형 · 프렌치브레이드 · 스트로베리블론드 · 메이크업 비주얼계 · 금속 은 · 공예 혼합 3종(Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern+Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework+Filipino Yakan painted pattern) · 가로 띠 · 체형 풍만한 가슴·넓은 어깨(아워글래스))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head to just below her chest, the frame cutting off beneath the chest. Her face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, a cold, poised expression, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick silver septum ring with a smaller silver ring above it and two silver rings through each nostril; a straight silver bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three silver pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a silver Medusa stud above the lips; a big silver hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a silver labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small silver studs along each jaw; a curved row of small silver studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized silver hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine silver chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. All jewelry is real silver, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a full, curvy bust with soft broad shoulders and an hourglass figure.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in 3 different traditional patterns, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the patterns reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her body below the collarbones is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with fine filigree linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, with geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. The patterns of every region continue in full strength over her chest, shoulders and arms, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
